hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if ! git fetch --all --prune --quiet; then echo 'git fetch failed: main may be out of date.'; exit 0; fi; b=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$b" != main ]; then echo "This checkout is on '$b', not main: main was not updated. Tell the user before starting."; elif [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo 'main has local changes: it was not updated. Tell the user before starting.'; elif git merge --ff-only --quiet origin/main 2>/dev/null; then echo 'main is up to date with origin/main.'; else echo 'main cannot fast-forward to origin/main: it was not updated. Tell the user before starting.'; fi
